services.name: Boat Charters
services.desc: Ready to reel in the big one? Cast your line into the legendary waters of South Padre Island with a private bay fishing charter from SPI Excursions. We offer a personalized angling adventure perfect for everyone, from seasoned pros to first-time fishers. Our expert guides know all the best spots and are committed to making your trip not just successful, but truly unforgettable. Book your private charter today and get ready for the thrill of your next great catch! We offer two departure times to fit your schedule: a morning trip at 7:00 AM and an afternoon trip at 1:30 PM. services.name: Sunset Cruise

services.name: Banana Boat
services.desc: Hold on tight! Get ready for an action-packed ride across the waves with our Banana Boat Rides in South Padre Island. It’s the perfect way to add a splash of fun and adventure to your beach day. Gather your friends and family, and book your ride today to make some unforgettable memories on the water. A banana boat ride offers a thrilling experience on a large inflatable raft, accommodating up to six passengers. Life jackets are provided for all riders to ensure safety. Expect to get wet and possibly fall in, which adds to the excitement. Wear a swimsuit or comfortable water-friendly clothing. services.name: Parasailing in South Padre Island
services.desc: Soar high above the clear waters of South Padre Island on the ultimate parasailing adventure. Take in stunning coastal views, feel the ocean breeze, and enjoy a smooth, exhilarating ride you’ll never forget. Spots fill up fast, so book your unforgettable island adventure today by calling us or visiting our website. Our 31-foot, Coast Guard-certified Ocean Pro vessel can accommodate up to 12 passengers for a safe and comfortable ride.
